scoring_justification: Absolute binding energies depend on DFT software/basis; T1 recompute infeasible because checker cannot re-run full DFT. Ordering verification robustly captures the paper's claim.

hidden_assets.purpose: Required ordering Ni4Zn > NiZn4 > Zn5 > Co4Zn by binding strength (largest magnitude first)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 6 and main conclusion ("Ni₄Zn > NiZn₄ > Zn₅ > Co₄Zn")
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the paper's own reported trend, not an invented gold.

outputs.description: First CO2 binding energies for the four metal-exchanged clusters. The checker verifies the presence of all four clusters with 'distal' isomer and the exact relative ordering: Ni4Zn > NiZn4 > Zn5 > Co4Zn.

output_contract.notes: Only the relative ordering of binding energies is scored; absolute values are not compared. The output must contain exactly four entries with the specified cluster names and 'distal' isomer.

steps.description: Verify the presence of all four clusters with 'distal' isomer and the correct ordering Ni4Zn > NiZn4 > Zn5 > Co4Zn (by absolute binding energy).
